fieldValues.title: Address
fieldValues.description: A stable identifier for anything that can be referred to, across document, process and conversation space and across repositories. The Address is core (RFC-049): an implementation resolves an Address only within its boundary, the set of repositories the implementation declares; an Address it cannot resolve stays valid.
fieldValues.notes: The Address names; a registry locates (ext:registry). The live cursor that points at an Address while a session runs, AttentionState, is ext:addressability's, and must not be confused with the Address itself.
